prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Pakistani man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth light-brown skin with a warm undertone, a confident smirk, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum necklaces. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up, yellow reflective-striped suspenders running over his bare shoulders and chest, and a minimal glossy mirror-polished metallic red T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a yellow reflective stripe, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Brazilian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth warm bronze skin, a warm natural smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a lead barrel-shaped weight, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold ship's anchor, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge, two silver dog-tag chains hanging on his bare chest, and a minimal camouflage-pattern T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme olive-green platform loafers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
